claude.text: agnts codes with Claude using your own key. You can also manage it from Claude chat through its MCP server.

github.text: agnts clones your repository, works on its own branch, and opens the pull request as you after you approve.

gitlab.text: The same flow for GitLab: its own branch for every task, and a merge request only after your approval.

jira.text: Add the agnts label to a ticket. agnts reads it, asks its questions there, and updates the ticket when the pull request is open.

connectors.lead: Connect your tracker, your repositories and Claude once. agnts takes the work from there.
connectors.title: Works with the tools you already use.

contact.text: Free while agnts is in demo, then $25 a month. Nothing to install, and your approval on every push.

faq.a2: No. The agent inside the container can't push or deploy. agnts pushes only after you approve the diff, and production deploys happen only when you press the button.
faq.a3: agnts reads the code first, then asks short questions with options. Coding starts only after you answer, so you don't get invented features.
faq.a4: agnts runs Claude Code on your plan, so you control the model costs and there are no surprise bills from us. agnts tracks your limits and pauses before they run out.
faq.a5: Yes. You can create tasks for side projects directly in agnts.
faq.a6: No. Juniors use it to move faster and learn from the diffs; seniors use it to clear routine tickets and stay on the hard problems.
